daily_1.name: Daily Task: Deployment
daily_1.description: Complete raid(s) on any map (including failed attempts).

daily_5.name: Daily Task: Combat
daily_5.description: Eliminate a specific number of enemies.

daily_12.name: Daily Task: Collection
objectives: Turn in Medical supplies Found In Raid

daily_13.name: Daily Task: Collection
objectives: Turn in Household Items Found In Raid

daily_14.name: Daily Task: Collection
objectives: Turn in Batteries Items Found In Raid

ark_36.name: Seaside Pursuit
ark_36.description: Graves is down — ARK's top brass has collapsed, but what they left behind didn't go anywhere. The military dropped a load of gear when they pulled out from the seaside. Go pick up the trail. Rua Algasol Street, Victoria Hotel, Whitesail Hospital East Wing — hit all three and extract. Remember: ARK isn't finished, and the Insane-tier threats haven't stopped.
objectives: Reach the east of White Sails Hospital

ark_37.name: Rangefinder Scope
ark_37.description: First target: ARK's rangefinder scope. One's stashed somewhere along the seaside. Find it and drop it off at the back of the small seaside restaurant — I've got someone there to collect it. This isn't just any piece of kit, the Insane remnants use it for long-range targeting.
objectives: Place in the Seafoam Scoops' backyard

ark_38.name: Police Car Photos
ark_38.description: Two police cars at the resort bank — one in front, one in the back. Get me shots of the plates and the sides. Graves' people stashed critical documents in a hidden compartment in the trunk. I'll give you a phone — take the photos and send them back. This AR15 50-round drum is something only a veteran can hand out — you'll need it at Insane tier.
objectives: Take photo of a police car (Front of the bank)
Take photo of a police car (Back of the bank)

ark_39.name: Keeping the Peace
ark_39.description: The fire station, east military camp, and Khalif Travel Agency — all three are being used by Graves' ARK remnants as staging points. Clear at least 6 sentries and confirm all three locations. I've got a full AUG kit ready for you — 42-round mag, 510mm barrel, front grip. Fully kitted out this thing can run as a sniper or an assault rifle.

ark_40.name: First Test: BMP Marking
ark_40.description: Three ARK remnant BMPs are patrolling the resort — I'm giving you three trackers, tag all of them. These aren't easy targets, Insane-tier APCs, you'll need to plan your approach. I'm throwing in another EVO3 Ultra — higher fire density up close than the standard. Plus 9mm tracer rounds — essential for low-light combat.

ark_41.name: ★15 Pushing the Limit Lv4
ark_41.description: This is a real trust test. The vault breach point, construction site, garbage dump, staff quarters — confirm all four, and bring back 5 pieces of intel. Insane-tier enemies won't let you off easy — but if you make it out alive, the shop goes up to Lv4 and I'll show you something: the XM5 Light. Next-generation rifle the military left behind, 6.8x51 caliber, unlike anything you've used before.
objectives: Turn in Intel Items Found In Raid

ark_42.name: ★18 Judgment Day BOSS
ark_42.description: After Graves went down, ARK remnants set up a squad in the staff quarters — the leader is his former estate manager, goes by 'Tattoo'. Graves' old weapons cache is all in his hands. Go take him out and turn the page on ARK for good. This AR15 60-round drum is the heaviest thing I've ever handed out — Lv4-tier firepower. Come back alive and I'll buy you a drink.

ark_43.name: Into the Underground
ark_43.description: Tattoo's dead, ARK's chapter is closed. But there's one more road for you — the metro. After the military pulled out, they left people underground still guarding 'the last thing'. I'll give you a metro pass, bring plenty of ammo — feel out the dog head statue, public bathhouse, and medical base first and see what you can find.
objectives: Find the Underground Medical Base's Hall

ark_44.name: Undercurrent
ark_44.description: The metro scavengers are tougher than anything on the surface — Insane-tier armor, heavy suppressing fire. Clear 18 of them. You're already comfortable with the EVO3 Ultra, here's another one — drum mag and tracer rounds, unreasonable at close range. Another metro pass for you too. If the XM5 Light isn't unlocked yet, it will be after this.

ark_45.name: Deep Roots I
ark_45.description: The hidden passages in the metro bathroom and warehouse — find both of them, then extract from underground twice. These routes are critical for surviving Phase 7 — know them well and getting out becomes a lot easier. I'm giving you the AUG A3 M1 Optic — the ultimate AUG with an integrated sight. Mag and Insane-tier M995 AP rounds included.
objectives: Find the Secret Passage in the Restroom of the Metro
Find the Secret Passage in the Warehouse of the Metro

reward.item_name: AUG A3 M1 5.56x45mm assault rifle Optic edition

ark_46.name: Heavy Iron: Tank Marking
ark_46.description: Three BMP tanks are sitting in the metro — the ones without red cross markings, don't touch the ones that have it, those are medical vehicles. Mark all three. Pay close attention to the reward for this one: SECA17 FDE — MK17 in FDE finish, 7.62x51 battle rifle, faster than the M40A5 bolt-action, steadier than the AR308 semi. You know your .308 ammo well by now — time for the SECA to take the stage.
objectives: Mark BMP Tank without Medical signs

ark_47.name: Show of Force I: M4A1
ark_47.description: SIDE mission — take out 16 enemies using your M4A1 series weapon. Proficiency check. Complete it and I'll show you the XM5 Light — the military's next generation, 6.8x51 caliber. Lighter than the M4, more accurate than the AR15. This is the start of a new era.

ark_48.name: Show of Force IV: AUG
ark_48.description: SIDE wave two — take out 18 enemies with your AUG series. Complete it and you'll get the SECA17 in black. You're already familiar with the MK17 FDE finish — the black version is more low-profile, blends right into the shadows in the metro. The 6.8x51 AP round shop will open up too.

ark_49.name: ★19 Master of the Underground: Final BOSS
ark_49.description: The final fight — metro control room. When the military pulled out, one commander stayed behind, goes by 'The Captain'. He stayed to guard the last batch of XM5s — the flagship next-gen military version, XM5-2. The world owes you everything, and this is where it all gets paid back. Link up with Igor — he takes the east gate, you take the west, move at the same time. Take down The Captain and the XM5-2 is yours. From c.01 to today, I never misjudged you. Come back alive.

ark_50.name: Camera Placement: Warehouse & Supermarket
ark_50.description: The cameras I set up earlier were sabotaged. Head to the [warehouse next to the Office Building to retrieve the backup cameras I left there]. Redeploy them at the [pickup window of the food truck beside Altibuy] and on the [oil barrel next to the warehouse entrance]. Remember — this isn’t the scavenger zone near the dam anymore. The people in the mall are the real deal.
objectives: Place at Foodtruck; On the warehouse barrel

ark_51.name: Mall Photography
ark_51.description: The cameras picked something up — ARK has truck unloading points on every floor of the mall. Cover floors one, two, and three, and get photo evidence on each level. Keep it clean, don't let them spot you.
objectives: Find the Burger Store on the 1F of TRUPIK'S Mall
Find the Repair Store on the 2F of TRUPIK'S Mall
Find the Out-door gear store on the 3F of TRUPIK'S Mall
Take photo of the Burger store sign
Take photo of the Repair store sign
Take photo of the Out-door gear store sign

ark_52.name: Retrieve ARK Disks
ark_52.description: The bakery, canal farm, and seaside supply point — each one has an ARK disk hidden inside. Bring all three back to me, this is more critical than the truck photos. Stay sharp, the mall isn't the dam — someone will be watching.
objectives: Arrive the farm west of Hyder Town
Find the Supply Truck in the southwest

ark_53.name: Hide Discs
ark_53.description: Now, I need you to assist my informant. Head to the [Recreation Room in Trupiks], [Mall Surveillance Room 1], and [Mall Surveillance Room 2]. Place a set of [Discs] at each location.
objectives: Arrive the recreation room on the 3F of Trupiks Mall
Arrive surveillance room 1 on the 1F of Trupiks Mall
Arrive surveillance room 2 on the 1F of Trupiks Mall

ark_54.name: ★ The Traitor BOSS
ark_54.description: Alright — ARK's man running the mall used to be a comrade of mine. He sold us out, and now he's calling the shots from the rooftop. Get up there, kill him, and wipe the evidence off those discs. This M40A5 is what I've been saving — .308 caliber, it'll punch right through his heavy armor. I've already fitted the scope and rail, ready to use the moment you pick it up. This is the best thing I can give you — make sure you bring it back.
objectives: Find the Rooftop of TRUPIK'S Mall

ark_55.name: Disguised Baseball
ark_55.description: Mall business is done. We’re moving to the dam — head to the dock office and the small shop next to it, and retrieve two surveillance devices disguised as baseballs. I need you to bring them back for analysis. How’s the M40A5 feeling after a few days? Bring an AR15 Hunter as a secondary — bolt-action rifles aren’t great up close.

reward.item_name: AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

ark_56.name: New Bridge Maintenance
ark_56.description: Mark the two bridge pillars under the broken dam bridge — one on the east side, one on the west. Then drop three MP5 30-round magazines into the container at the bridge head, my contact is there and will pick them up.
objectives: Put magazine Mag MP5 30rnd in place

ark_57.name: Clifton Recon
ark_57.description: There are several ARK supply points around Clifton — the grocery store, the barbershop, and the toll station. Check them one by one and see how much intel you can gather. Then extract from the dam twice to get familiar with the new routes.
objectives: Arrive the grocery store in Clifton

reward.item_name: AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

ark_58.name: Factory Oil Tanks
ark_58.description: Three green oil tanks in Factory Zone A at the dam — mark all of them. The distances aren't short, this is where the M40A5 actually earns its keep. Bring your sniper setup, find high ground, mark all three tanks and extract.
objectives: Mark the Green Storagetank 1 in Factory A Zone
Mark the Green Storagetank 2 in Factory A Zone
Mark the Green Storagetank 3 in Factory A Zone

ark_59.name: ★ Silver Skull BOSS
ark_59.description: Igor's in too. There's a liaison hiding in the dam's electrical room — someone running comms between ARK and the WP rebels. Both sides want him dead. Link up with Igor and go in together — he takes the main route, you take the side entrance. Take this guy out and I'll give you the best reward you've seen since Phase 3. Come back alive.

reward.item_name: AUG A3 M1 5.56x45mm assault rifle CQB edition

ark_60.name: M16A2 Proficiency
ark_60.description: Show of force — take down 12 ARK targets using the M16A2. This is a veteran's test, prove you can actually work with iron sights and a 4x scope. Complete it and I'll give you the AR308 — the ultimate form of the .308 NA rifle.

ark_61.name: MK17 Proficiency
ark_61.description: The resort — ARK mercenaries are stationed there. Take out 14 of them using the MK17. This is the ultimate test of the .308 platform: bolt-action with the M40A5, semi-auto with the AR308, battle-ready with the MK17 — master all three and it's perfect. Last one to add to the collection is the G3 AK4, the German army's workhorse from the 60s.

ark_1.name: Handshake
ark_1.description: New blood. I'm Tommy, ARK Industries. This place is crawling with scavengers — go take out a few and prove you're not useless.
ark_1.tips: Check the 'Extraction' tab in the menu or use the M.I.C.A. map to find extraction points.

ark_62.name: Wind Farm Recon
ark_62.description: How's the CAR15 treating you? There's ARK movement at the wind farm — head over and see what's going on.

ark_3.name: Recon 1
ark_3.description: You're getting more reliable. I need some intel — go scavenge around and bring back whatever looks valuable.
objectives: Turn in Intel Items Found In Raid

reward.item_name: MP5A4 9x19mm sub-machine gun Suppressed Walther edition

ark_3.tips: The Military Camp is north of the Mall. [Intel items](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items?category=misc&subcategory=Intel) are commonly found in that area.

ark_63.name: Prove Yourself
ark_63.description: You're ready. There's a critical ARK document hidden at the front desk of the dock office at the dam. Find it and bring it back — do that, and I'll get you the fuel to power up the base.

ark_64.name: New Friends
ark_64.description: It’s time for some introductions—I've got a lot of history with the folks in the Market, and they’ll be your go-to for supplies from now on. ARK has hidden two tracker prototypes at the suburban supermarket—one in the bathroom and the other on the roof, which you'll need a ladder to reach. Bring them both back to me.

ark_65.name: Truck Marking
ark_65.description: ARK supply trucks have been showing up in the outskirts lately. Mark three of them for me — I need to map out their transport routes. Take the M16, I'm throwing in a rail mount too — slap a scope on it and you're good to go.

reward.item_name: AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

ark_66.name: Clearing Drill
ark_66.description: Got the truck route. You did well. Take out some Scavengers with your MP5 first—do that, and I'll give you an MP9 to see how it feels.

ark_67.name: Transport Clues
ark_67.description: The marked truck has provided a lead—the freight route leads to a specific location. Go there and scout it out. When you get back, this EVO3 is yours—it's a CZ Skorpion, much more agile than a rifle for close-quarters spraying

ark_68.name: Rifle Drills
ark_68.description: Iron Wolf's location is confirmed — second floor of the police station. He's got heavy armor, you'll need a rifle to deal with him. Go get some practice in with the AR15. This EVO3 Ultra is the upgraded version — more firepower than the standard, still useful up close.

ark_69.name: Pre-war Recon
ark_69.description: Iron Wolf's stronghold hasn't been pinned down yet—it could be the open-air cinema or the office building, I can't confirm from here. Can you scout both locations? Clear out any Scavengers in the vicinity while you're at it.

ark_70.name: ★ First Hunt: Iron Wolf
ark_70.description: You ready? Iron Wolf is on the second floor of the police station. Heavy armor, heavy firepower, and he knows his exits. Take him down and get out alive — this SCAR and 4x scope are the best I've been holding back. This is the most important fight you've had since you got here.
objectives: Reach the Hyder Town Police Station
Eliminate Iron Wolf in Police Station

forge_5.name: No Caller Rejected
forge_5.description:
Heard about that recent heist in the [Resort Area]? Everyone's scrambling to find ways to launder the loot, and there's no way I'm sitting that out.
Take this [phone] and place it at the [Wall Fountain in the Rua Algasol].
Someone will reach out to me,no names, no questions.
If you lose the task item, please come back to me to repurchase it.
objectives: Place in the wall fountain in Rua Algasol
forge_5.tips: Small fountain on wall in Rua Algasol.

forge_6.name: Hovolt Smuggling
forge_6.description:
Ever heard of Hovolt cars? Gorgeous machines,sleek design, purr like a dream.
There's a dealership in the [Resort Area] still intact. I want a few rides from there... eventually.
But first, do me a favor: [snap a picture of every color variant] they've got in the showroom.
I need to confirm the stock.
objectives: Take photo of a black Hovolt car
Take photo of a yellow Hovolt car
Take photo of a blue Hovolt car
Take photo of a red Hovolt car
forge_6.tips: Car dealership located east side by tunnel extract. All required cars are nearby.

forge_7.name: Bargain Hunter
forge_7.description:
Word is the northern gang's got their eyes on that mythical gem.
Seems like everything else is beneath them now. Fools.
You head to the [Flea Market] in the [Resort Area] and see what's been overlooked.
They might've missed some [antiques], and I'm more than happy to take those off their hands.
objectives: Turn in Antique Tea Plate - Yang
Turn in Antique Tea Plate - Yin

forge_8.name: Hidden in Plain Sight
forge_8.description: The cops in Hydertown seem to be in a standoff with gang members. But one of them approached me to handle some valuable goods he secretly siphoned off. Turns out I've got some money stashed in the city, just enough to trade with him. Go to [Resort Area] and find the money I hid near the [garbage trucks] at the [Fire Department], [Garbage Station], and [Workers Dorm]. Once you’ve got the money, place it next to the fountain in front of [Halif Voyage].

forge_10.name: Freight Runner
forge_10.description: My men died while transporting goods in [Resort Area]. This shipment is urgent, and right now, you're the only one I can think of to help me, friend! I need you to take over the undelivered cargo, it's in [the supermarket at Crimson Luxe -1F]. Then place the goods at the [eastern skybridge], [western corridor], and [hospital corridor].

forge_12.name: No Deal, No Mercy
forge_12.description:
Remember that cop who wanted to fence stolen goods? Damn pig never intended to hand over the goods from the start. I need to show him what happens when you play games doing business with me!
Alright partner, head to [Silverwave Bank] and teach the leader of that [Barricade] a lesson. But be careful, he's definitely prepared. He's the one dressed head-to-toe in gear.
forge_12.tips: SWAT boss located at the Bank main entrance.(Not Bonecrusher in yellow helmet)

forge_31.name: The Collector
forge_31.description:
Trends in collectibles have shifted. Now everyone's into action figure toys.
I'll admit, I used to think they were just decorations, but you know what? Collecting stuff really is fun. Watching your storage slowly fill up gives a certain... satisfaction.
Bring me a [full set of character figure toys], and make sure to include the [hidden variant]. I hear that one's more valuable, supposedly it has a [gold paint] finish.
forge_31.tips: Reward not worth it. Exchange gold figurine for Endgame equipment in official discord.

forge_32.name: Collectors Edition
forge_32.description:
I'd really like to show you my collection, but my shelf is just a few items away from perfection. I can't stand an incomplete collection.
Maybe you can help me complete the final piece: find me [a full set of Contractors game discs]. Note, there are [4 versions] in total: [one standard and one deluxe edition of Contractors], and [one standard and one deluxe edition of Showdown].
objectives: Turn in Contractors Game Disc Collector's Edition

forge_30.name: Virtual Realities
forge_30.description:
Hey, I heard there are [4 VR prototype units] on this island! I need you to find them for me, they're special collectibles for certain people.
But my intel is limited. I only know [the first one] is at [the Drive-in theater in Suburb Area]; [the other 3] are scattered somewhere in [Dam Area], [Smuggling Tunnel], and [Metro Area]. Hope you can spare some time to keep an eye out for them!
objectives: Find the VR Headset in Suburb area
Find the VR Headset in Dam area
Find the VR Headset in Metro area
Find VR Headset in Smuggling Tunnel

forge_26.name: Business Development
forge_26.description:
I think you should try extracting from multiple exfil points.
This is basically scouting work, don't rush, it's all preparation for future operations. Safely exfil once from each of these nearby locations: [Drive-in Theater in Suburb Area], [Convoy in Dam Area], and [the ambulance in Resort Area].
objectives: Extract from White Sail Hospital West

forge_28.name: Treasure Beyond Measure
forge_28.description:
That hacker sure took her time.
There wasn't much data inside, plus lots of useless junk files. But after her analysis, she found some important intel: a strange launcher program, a string of passwords, and a [location].
I'll focus on studying the link between the program and the passwords. You go check the [control room] in the subway at [Metro Area] and find a [special briefcase].

forge_29.name: Perfect Collaboration
forge_29.description:
You're back. Guess what you brought? Let me tell you, that earlier program is actually a missile launch program. And that case isn't just an ordinary computer. You need to connect the program from the hard drive into it and enter that password sequence to make the program run properly.
This thing's value is beyond money! Haha, you're my most efficient, most reliable partner.
Take this key. Get to [the locked room in the subway sewers in Metro Area]. Everything inside is yours, take as much as you can carry. Consider this your reward as my most valued business partner.
objectives: Find the Sewer Area Back Room

forge_15.name: Purge the Ranks
forge_15.description:
I've got something that needs handling now, and from what I gather, you're good at this kind of thing.
One of my men stole a few gold bars from me. It's not about the money, I can't stand people taking what's mine. That's betrayal. My other guys have already cornered him inside [Trupiks Mall]. Your job is simple: go to the room on [-1F], do whatever it takes, and [get my gold back].
forge_15.tips: Located in the center of the Mall on -1F, in the room below escalator stairs.

forge_16.name: Better Safe than Sorry 2
forge_16.description:
In business, staying alert is everything. I have a few stash spots in [Suburb Area] that I use for storage and transfers during regular operations. I need to make sure they're always ready and intact.
Check these locations: [the water tower north of Altibuy], [the green tent in the square north of Trupiks], and [the small house past the overpass further north of the mall]. Once you've checked them thoroughly, extract back.
objectives: Find the water tower near the AltiBuy
Find the green tent in the TRUPIKS plaza
forge_16.tips: water tower (more of a tank than a tower) 50M north of altibuy in the backyard of the 3 story house, green tent located in front of mall northeast corner by overpass, cabin located north of mall just past overpass before tunnel

forge_17.name: Don't Play with Fire
forge_17.description:
My hiding spots are flawless. But some of them are at risk of accidental damage.
I need you to go check them and mark them with trackers so I can monitor the safety of my goods in real time. Location: [Farm Area], [mark the tall round silos up north]. And for safety, bring back any [flammable materials] nearby.
objectives: Turn in Combustible Items Found In Raid
forge_17.tips: These are *not* barns, they are tall silos.

forge_19.name: Cold Hard Cash 1
forge_19.description: Thanks to you, more clients have been coming my way lately. But some of these rich folks are getting more extravagant. Their requests often include items made of gold. With so many sudden demands, my supply isn't ready. Why don't you try your luck and find me a [gold ingot]?

forge_22.name: Cold Hard Cash 2
forge_22.description:
After comparing the gold bar you brought with the ones I got back earlier... I realized the recovered bars were fakes!
I must get my real gold back. The traitor left a contact clue, something about meeting a forklift driver disguised in [Dam Area].
Go to [Dam Area] and mark the [forklifts] at the [Dock] and [Old Factory]. I need more leads.
objectives: Mark the forklift 1 in Old Factory
Mark the forklift 2 in Old Factory

forge_25.name: Cold Hard Cash 3
forge_25.description:
All this trouble over a few gold ingots, I should've put holes in him from the start! Anyway, we found a new note under a forklift with location info and a riddle.
The gold is in [Dam Area]. The exact spot should be this riddle:
[Waves crash and builders scheme, a lift with a metal beam, see the gold where the heights convene.]
Sounds like you should look somewhere high up. Go get my [gold ingots] back.
forge_25.tips: Climb to the top of the crane. Acrophobia is a thing.

forge_27.name: Hack to Play
forge_27.description:
While inspecting the cargo, I discovered a specially encrypted hard drive. The encryption method is highly complex. This must be for a major deal! I need to ask a hacker friend of mine for help.
She is a total gaming enthusiast. So I need you to find limited‑edition game discs for me, that’s the only way she'll put aside her pride and help.
Search in [the Old Factory B‑area workshop in Dam Area] and [the pile of containers at the bottom of the dam]. Those places might have what we're looking for.

forge_13.name: All pieces together 3
forge_13.description:
Let's turn to another collection target: [old mobile phones]. Yeah, I know, they look like junk to you, but there's real value inside: information.
Business is all about information asymmetry. More intel means more options. Hell, just trading info can be more profitable than you'd think!

forge_14.name: All pieces together 4
forge_14.description:
While exploring, have you come across any valuable antiques?
Listen, I've recently had clients asking to buy second-hand cameras. They say it's some new photo trend.
Well, I'm not missing this chance. Try your luck, bring me a few [cameras]. Maybe I can make some profit off this trend.

forge_33.name: Console in the Hand
forge_33.description: Hey, didn't expect anyone here to still have old handheld consoles! Such nostalgia. Back in the day, I was the king of the kids in my neighborhood thanks to one of those! This is making me itch to play again. Do me a favor, get me a [game console] and [4 different] [game cartridges]!

forge_34.name: Referral Gift
forge_34.description: New blood? Tommy mentioned you over the radio. First job's gonna be a tough one — the rat hole under the dam. There's something valuable of mine in there: a golden globe. Bring it back as your introduction gift, and I'll set you up with real armor. Not that militia-grade soft vest garbage. Smugglers pass through that area sometimes — watch yourself.
objectives: Arrive the entrance to the Rat Hole
Arrive the exit of the Rat Hole

forge_35.name: Dam Aircraft Recon
forge_35.description: Don't just treat that JPC like another piece of clothing—you need to know how to use it. There’s a crash site over by the Dam Pier; I need photos to prove how much those old aircraft engines can be scrapped for. Go and photograph both engine locations. While you're at it, grab some household items from the wreckage—I've got a buyer paying per piece.
objectives: Turn in Household Items Found In Raid

forge_36.name: My Convoy
forge_36.description: My own convoy is parked at checkpoint 050 near the dam — those vehicles will engine up and pull out on schedule. If you ever need to bolt, you can hitch a ride. Go mark all three vehicle positions so you've got a clear picture in your head. Loot some electronics while you're at it — the newer the better, the kind that actually sells.
objectives: Turn in Electric Items Found In Raid

forge_37.name: Wyeth Farm
forge_37.description: I’ve got a golden goblet hidden away at Wyeth Farm in the suburbs—debt collected from a client who owed me money. Bring it back, and I’ll trade you another piece of gear.
objectives: Arrive the Bedroom in Wyeth farmhouse

forge_38.name: Suburban Recon
forge_38.description: Go recon a few key areas in the suburbs — checkpoint, parking lot, watchtower, hit them one by one, memorize the terrain and personnel layout. Have a plan to run, have a way out to survive. I don't teach for free — come back when you're done, armor upgrade.

forge_39.name: Hidden Path
forge_39.description: The bunker in the suburbs, I remember it's over by the Power Plant. Not many go in, and even fewer come out. Find that exit and extract from there. I'm not asking you to scout; I want you to remember it: if the main entrance is ever blocked, you'll still have a way out.

forge_40.name: Every Little Bit Counts
forge_40.description: An old client collects notebooks — doesn't matter who wrote them or what's inside, he pays per notebook. Pick some up when you're rummaging around, bring back a few and find me, paid per item.

forge_41.name: Another Order
forge_41.description: He was satisfied with that batch of notebooks; now there's another order — cassette tapes, the old-fashioned kind. Plenty of them in abandoned suburban houses and old cars, just grab them as you go. Bring back enough and come find me, same as last time.

forge_42.name: Rumors
forge_42.description:
Ah, there you are. I've got something that might interest you.
One of my contacts brought back some news. A group of newcomers has been asking around about the Dam's power facilities. Got me thinking there might be some money in it.
I heard they left behind a few intel phones. I've marked the locations.
Go bring them back.
Doesn't matter what's on them. Just bring them to me.
objectives: Find the phone at the crash site
Find the phone in the house opposite Ellie's Shop
Find the phone on the old car by the cemetery

forge_43.name: Recon
forge_43.description:
Looks like those phones paid off.
The newcomers are with Leopard Global Security. LGS for short. A well-equipped private military outfit.
I don't care why they're here. What I care about is whether they're going to interfere with my business.
A while back, some of their people got into a fight with scavengers in the Mall's B1 warehouse area and left a few bodies behind.
Go take a look. See if they left anything useful behind.
objectives: Take photo of the LGS operative body #1
Take photo of the LGS operative body #2
Take photo of the LGS operative body #3

forge_44.name: Stakeout
forge_44.description:
I've managed to track down a few LGS camps. Figured I'd keep an eye on them for a while.
The black truck near the main gate of the Dam Factory and the vehicles parked outside the Bank in Resort should make good observation points.
Go plant the trackers.
I've already sent the equipment to your mailbox.
And be careful. Nobody likes being watched.
objectives: Mark the truck at the front gate of the Dam Factory
Mark the truck at the rear gate of the Dam Factory
Mark the black car at the Resort Bank
Mark the blue car at the Resort Bank

forge_45.name: Cleanup
forge_45.description:
Looks like the trackers are onto something.
I've almost got LGS figured out, but the scavengers have been stirring up too much noise and muddying the data.
Clear them out — the Dam, the Resort, and the Suburbs. Don't miss any.
Use the pump-action shotgun. Makes it easier to pin the blame on LGS.
The gun's waiting in your mailbox. If you lose it, Tommy can get you another one.
Don't take too long.
objectives: Pump Shotgun: Eliminate targets in Dam Area
Pump Shotgun: Eliminate targets in Suburb Area
Pump Shotgun: Eliminate targets in Resort Area

preReward.item_name: M870 12ga pump action shotgun SHORTY edition

forge_46.name: Paper Trail
forge_46.description:
LGS keeps everything encrypted, but nobody covers their tracks perfectly.
Check the Sector 2 Ventilation Room in Smuggling Tunnel and the Bank in Resort.
If you find any internal LGS documents, bring them back.
And while you're there, deal with the scavengers in the tunnels. They've been causing problems for my smuggling routes.

forge_47.name: Bait
forge_47.description:
If they're so concerned about keeping this intel under wraps, well, let's help spread it around.
But first, deal with the scavengers in the area.
Then place those phones loaded with LGS intel at the designated locations.
The Police Station. The Restaurant. Leave one at each.
After that, we'll see what kind of trouble it stirs up.
objectives: Place in the police briefing room
Place at the diner front desk

forge_48.name: Golden Lion
forge_48.description:
Word is, before everything went south on the island, someone hid a golden lion statue at the Dam Factory.
You know I have a soft spot for that kind of thing, so I need you to do me a favor.
There aren't many leads, and the factory's been picked over more than once since then.
But I'm certain it's still somewhere in the factory.
And lately, LGS has been sending more elites into the area.
If you run into them, take care of them. They're nothing but trouble.
objectives: Eliminate LGS Lv4 in Dam Area
Eliminate LGS Lv5 in Dam Area

ntg_10.name: Clear the Way
ntg_10.description:
Everything we've tracked leads to Smuggling Tunnel.
LGS has been active there too.
I don't care what they're up to.
Deal with anyone in the way.
Don't let them get in the way of my business.

forge_49.name: Loose Ends
forge_49.description:
It's time to wrap things up.
The only ones left underground are LGS elites, so watch yourself.
And don't forget to bring back that LGS Medal from the bathroom.
I've got a feeling it'll come in handy someday.
objectives: Eliminate LGS Lv4 in Mero Area
Eliminate LGS Lv5 in Metro Area

gunsmith_1.name: The Gunsmith 'Color'
gunsmith_1.description: Ever thought about giving your firearms a makeover? I've got some spray paint cans here. You can use them at the [Spray Painting Station] to the right of the workbench to customize the colors and patterns of your gun parts. But first, I need you to gather some supplies for me. Go find some [Batteries] and [spray cans].
objectives: Turn in Batteries Items Found In Raid

gunsmith_3.name: The Gunsmith 'Rebuild'
gunsmith_3.description: Retrieve the [AR15 Hunter] from the mailbox and mount it on the gunsmith bench. Load the components from the mail into the storage bay of the [Conveyor Belt] next to the bench. Swap out the wooden [Handguard], [Pistol Grip], and [Stock] of the AR15 Hunter with the three new components provided. Deliver the modified firearm to me.
objectives: Install M4 Factory original pistol grip

gunsmith_5.name: The Gunsmith 'Assemble'
gunsmith_5.description:
Get all the 1911 parts from the mailbox, then head to the gunsmith station to assemble the weapon.
Finally, submit the completed gun to me.

gunsmith_7.name: The Gunsmith 'Attach'
gunsmith_7.description:
Retrieve the G3 from the mailbox.
Modify weapon to meet the objectives and submit it.

reward.item_name: G3 AR Buffer tube stock adapter

gunsmith_9.name: M16 Modification Trial
gunsmith_9.description: Modify weapon to meet the objectives and submit it.

gunsmith_11.name: G3 Modification Trial
gunsmith_11.description: Modify weapon to meet the objectives and submit it.

gunsmith_13.name: M870 Modification Trial
gunsmith_13.description: Modify weapon to meet the objectives and submit it.

gunsmith_15.name: SKS Modification Trial
gunsmith_15.description: Modify weapon to meet the objectives and submit it.

gunsmith_17.name: AK74N Modification Trial
gunsmith_17.description: Modify weapon to meet the objectives and submit it.

gunsmith_2.name: Workshop Interview
gunsmith_2.description: I'm Anna. Johnny mentioned you—said you're good with your hands, not just at pulling triggers. Now that the base has power, it's time someone put this workbench to use. Let’s see what you’ve got—install this M4 lower receiver.

gunsmith_4.name: The Lost Part
gunsmith_4.description: Want to build a gun that's truly yours? First, you need a proper barrel. Go find a 508mm long barrel. Drop anyone in your way and bring it back—intact. I don't take bent ones. Or, you might be able to score one from Tommy.

gunsmith_6.name: The Artisan's Touch
gunsmith_6.description: Now you have all the parts, go try the gunsmith bench. — Upper receiver, long barrel, ACOG, suppressor, plus pick a tactical accessory to tame the recoil. Sit down at the bench and assemble them one by one starting from the lower receiver.

gunsmith_8.name: Field Test
gunsmith_8.description: Target practice doesn't count. This gun needs to taste blood to mean anything — head to the burger joint on the 1st floor of the Mall and take out a few scavengers with your AR15. Come back and tell me how it feels.
objectives: Find the Burger Store on the 1F of TRUPIK'S Mall

gunsmith_10.name: The Last Screw Before Iron Wolf
gunsmith_10.description: Tommy's been pushing you — Iron Wolf is holed up at the police station. Before you take this gun in, I need to do one last fine-tune. I'll push the firepower to where I like it (100%). This is the best scope I can give you — HAMR 4x. No fancy red dots for a BOSS fight.

gunsmith_12.name: Parts Upgrade
gunsmith_12.description: I need you to find the storage rooms marked [WH] inside the Smuggling Tunnel — two in the East Zone, one in the West Zone. I also need some tools — 9 of them will do. Head in, come back, and I'll unlock a batch of VSS special-round barters — the 9x39 AP isn't sold in any shop, barter is the only way.
objectives: Turn in Tools Items Found In Raid

gunsmith_14.name: Protection Racket
gunsmith_14.description:
To infiltrate and dismantle this transport line, we've gotta grease some palms to get our shot.
Listen up, head to the [guard post] near the [southern elevator] in the [Smuggling Tunnel] and grab the cash we've stashed. Then drop it in the designated cardboard boxes to butter up our contacts at these locations:
[Control room], [Dock], [Warehouse], [Southern elevator].
objectives: Find money at Southern tunnel post

gunsmith_16.name: Close Quarters — MP9 Drill
gunsmith_16.description: Time for your MP9 to draw blood. Narrow alleys in the Smuggling Tunnel — [15 targets]. Forget the Malyuk; SMGs rule in places like this. Extract from map5 when it's done.

gunsmith_18.name: Smuggling Route: Surveillance I
gunsmith_18.description: Tommy wants intel — help him install cameras at several spots in the smuggler's corridor. Once done, I'll equip you with a 60-round magazine.

gunsmith_19.name: Malyuk Field Trial
gunsmith_19.description: The Malyuk is a Ukrainian mongrel — part AK, part AR. Take out [18 targets] using the Malyuk. All kills must be completed within the [Smuggling Tunnel]. Let me see if your trigger work and this gun’s alloy are a good fit. I’m throwing in an extended G18C Mag — time to upgrade your sidearm too.

gunsmith_20.name: White Virus
gunsmith_20.description: White ARK's database needs to be wiped. Four floppy disks — plant two of them at designated spots (a/b) to inject the virus, and bring the other two back to me so I can develop a counter-agent from them. Finish this and I'll unlock the 7.62x39 AP v2 barter — Igor's AKM can finally punch through Hard armor.
objectives: Placement 2: The 2F corridor of Ventilation Room 1
Placement 1: the room on the 2F at Cargo Area 01

gunsmith_21.name: Secure the Retreat — LMG Suppression
gunsmith_21.description: The deep Smuggling Tunnel needs to be cleared out — [18 targets], [LMG only]. Machine guns only show their real teeth in the deep. Finish this and I'll unlock the 545 AP v2 barter for you — Igor's AK-74M can finally show its true precision.

gunsmith_22.name: Smuggling Route: Surveillance II
gunsmith_22.description: Second batch of cameras — near ventilation room No. 2. I need more information to confirm. Done and I'll unlock the good 762x51 AP v1 rounds.

gunsmith_23.name: Data Smuggling
gunsmith_23.description: Critical intel is hidden within the smuggling tunnels. Infiltrate the depths to seize the Encrypted USB and all intel items. You must manually trigger the extraction switch to escape. This is a suicide mission—survive at all costs.
objectives: Find the ventilation room control panel
Turn in Intel Items Found In Raid

gunsmith_24.name: White Recorder Retrieval
gunsmith_24.description: 4 white recorders — these are ARK's final communications. Collect them all and put them in the cardboard box in the room with the turtle — my personal obsession, don't ask. Done and 762x54r AP v1 barter for you — the SVD can finally show its true power.
objectives: Find the White Recorder on the topfloor of dock office
Find the White Recorder in the red boat
Find the White Recorder in Ventilation Room 1
Find the White Recorder in control room

gunsmith_25.name: The Real Iron Wolf
gunsmith_25.description: There's another Iron Wolf underground — the real one. The first was Tommy's — that was just a warm-up. This one's hide hangs in the deepest part of the Smuggling Tunnel. Kill it, and you're a master gunsmith. Everything I've built with Johnny — full-caliber top-tier ammo plus the Lv4 parts pool — has been for today. Take your strongest gun, your best attachments, your hardest armor — and bring it down.
objectives: Eliminate Iron Wolf in Smuggling Tunnel
